Native filesystem watching and legacy Node ABI review (2026-10-21)

fsevents 1.0.14 is identical to npm's published tarball (SHA256
7014c0558201514fd12f84578bd1bde9d55da5ce455f3c844e67ae0a20cc5bf0).
Its Node 0.10 module imports node::MakeCallback and exports _fse_module;
it predates node_module_register. Rizin confirms its FSEventStreamCreate
callback queues path/flag/id records for delivery through uv_async and V8.
It has no added network or command-execution path. The legacy fixture is
that MIT-licensed module, SHA256
5130bb1f358cbc73943e31e973259fbc60ec9227da68b0498dd48cdfd03da8b8.

The existing mismatch finding claimed missing recognizable Node ABI evidence
despite an actual Node C++ import. Add a structured ABI import observation,
and use it in the mismatch exclusion without changing existing matchers.
Keep the historically reclaimed S3 dependency host suspicious: the benign
bundled binaries do not remove the install-time dependency risk.

Consumer audit: the prior ABI-name observation is referenced only by the
native-addon mismatch composite. The mismatch feeds the VS Code startup
native-import objective and encoded-state-dispatch objective. Existing
native-import-iife.vsix and native-abi-mismatch.vsix controls retain both
applicable suspicious objectives. No attack rule or severity is removed.
The new ABI atom does not join any positive directory selector.

Full tarball rescans retain both suspicious findings (root and manifest).
Only the false ABI mismatch is removed. Cleave also stops emitting the
unreferenced baseline import-count and .node-extension prerequisites on the
three native members and archive parent. Their rules and matchable facts
are unchanged; the replacement ABI finding and watcher import remain visible.
No suspicious or hostile detection is lost, including on the attack controls.

Add FSEventStreamCreate import coverage at fs/watch. The pre-existing shell
literal rule remains intact. The import observation neither infers browser
settings writes nor changes that shell rule's consumers. Its nearest neighbor
is directory traversal: monitoring events does not enumerate a directory.
Both additions use existing leaf directories and admit no new partition.

Run: python3 testdata/taxonomy/native-fsevents-abi/verify.py
The four compiled controls have corresponding C++ sources. Rebuild on macOS:
clang++ -dynamiclib -undefined dynamic_lookup -O0 <source.cpp> -o <name.node>
Controls distinguish imported APIs from quoted text, local definitions and
an unrelated namespace. The imports control intentionally establishes both
watching and Node ABI evidence; the claims are independent and may overlap.
